subject: mathematics
concept: Comparing quantities using percentage (e.g. what percent one amount is of another)
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student compares two virtual quantities and expresses one as a percent of the other
exercise.pictorial: Student uses a bar model to express a part as a percent of a labeled whole
exercise.abstract: Student calculates what percent one given quantity is of another

misconception_flags: divides in the wrong order (whole ÷ part instead of part ÷ whole)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
